acceptance_criteria.criterion: When an engine is selected, PhysicsOverview displays top speed (m/s) and acceleration (m/s²) as AbsoluteMetricCard components
When no engine is selected, absolute metric cards are hidden — no null or N/A clutter
ComparisonView includes absolute metric data from PhysicsResponse
EnginePerformanceDisplay shows top speed for normal/boost/travel modes alongside existing TWR
Existing percentage-based display remains intact — absolute metrics are additive
All modified files compile under TypeScript strict mode
